summary: This bill prohibits enforcement of Clean Air Act requirements for installing, certifying, or maintaining emissions control devices or onboard diagnostic systems on any motor vehicles, nullifies related regulations, eliminates all civil and criminal liability for noncompliance, and vacates prior penalties with expungement of records.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget authority. It focuses exclusively on regulatory prohibitions under the Clean Air Act.
No tax provisions, rate changes, credits, or revenue measures appear in the bill text.
The legislation does not address healthcare delivery, insurance, public coverage, or market-based reforms.
No references to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill does not touch on immigration policy, border enforcement, or pathways to citizenship.
No provisions related to reproductive rights or abortion access.
No military, defense, or national security spending or policy changes.

The bill explicitly prohibits enforcement of Clean Air Act emissions control requirements for motor vehicles, repeals related regulations, eliminates liability for non-compliance, and vacates penalties. This directly limits environmental regulations on vehicle emissions and pollution control.
No welfare, entitlement, or social safety net programs are mentioned.
The bill has no connection to schools, education funding, or school choice.
No drug enforcement, decriminalization, or controlled substances provisions.

Section 2(e) vacates criminal penalties and requires expungement of records for violations of emissions device laws. This is a narrow decriminalization measure but does not address broader sentencing reform or policing.
No trade agreements, tariffs, or import/export regulations are addressed.
The bill does not reference deficits, debt reduction, or fiscal policy.
No provisions concerning LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
No foreign aid, international assistance, or related funding measures.
The legislation contains nothing related to voting access, election integrity, or electoral procedures.
No technology regulation, data privacy, or surveillance provisions.
No labor, union, or workplace rights language.
The bill does not address religious exemptions or anti-discrimination protections.
